title: OMA 可观测
description: 总览看用户是否顺利；会话启动到平台依赖按用户旅程看每个环节的量、成功率、耗时与积压；会话诊断看单个会话。问题会话表与最慢的回合表点击行即跳到会话诊断。稀有事件逐条统计 trace/日志，高频耗时用指标。

panels.title: 回合成功率
panels.description: end_turn 占已结束回合的比例；requires_action 是等待用户确认，不计入分母

queries.query: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oma_stop_reason = 'end_turn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN oma_stop_reason <> 'requires_action' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE operation_name = 'oma.session.status' AND oma_event_type = 'session.status_idle'

panels.title: 已结束回合
panels.description: 所选时间范围内会话进入 idle 的次数

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE operation_name = 'oma.session.status' AND oma_event_type = 'session.status_idle'

panels.title: 用户等首 token p95
panels.description: user.message 写入到下一次模型调用产出首 token 的时间，最接近用户体感

queries.query: WITH e AS (SELECT oma_session_id, operation_name, _timestamp, LEAD(operation_name) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_op, LEAD(_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_ts, LEAD(oma_model_time_to_first_token_s) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_ttft FROM oma_server WHERE (operation_name = 'POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/events' AND oma_input_event_types LIKE '%user.message%') OR operation_name LIKE 'chat %') SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile_cont((next_ts - _timestamp) / 1000000.0 + CAST(next_ttft AS DOUBLE), 0.95), 2) AS y_axis_1 FROM e WHERE operation_name = 'POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/events' AND next_op LIKE 'chat %'

panels.title: 模型调用错误率
panels.description: chat span 为 Error 且不是调用方取消

queries.query: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' AND error_type <> 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE operation_name LIKE 'chat %'

panels.title: 工具调用失败率
panels.description: 沙箱 tools/call 中 outcome 不是 ok/canceled 的比例（tool_error、sandbox_unavailable 等）

queries.query: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oma_outcome NOT IN ('ok', 'canceled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE operation_name = 'oma.sandbox_mcp.call' AND oma_mcp_method = 'tools/call'

panels.title: 卡住的会话
panels.description: running 但长时间没有新事件（stale_running_after）

panels.title: 等待执行端
panels.description: Brain 等待执行端的会话（等待领取 + 待接管）+ 排队中的启动任务

panels.title: 错误日志

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE severity = 'ERROR'

panels.title: 回合结果（按 stop reason）
panels.description: 每个时间桶内结束的回合数；end_turn 以外都需要关注

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, oma_stop_reason AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE operation_name = 'oma.session.status' AND oma_event_type = 'session.status_idle' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: 问题事件（按类型）
panels.description: session.error、失败回合、工具/模型错误、启动与 E2B 失败、HTTP 5xx；逐条计数，不受计数器首次累加问题影响

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.session.error' THEN 'session.error' WHEN operation_name = 'oma.session.status' THEN '回合失败:' || oma_stop_reason WHEN operation_name = 'oma.sandbox_mcp.call' THEN '工具:' || oma_outcome WHEN operation_name LIKE 'chat %' THEN '模型:' || error_type WHEN operation_name LIKE 'oma.runner.%' THEN '启动:' || COALESCE(oma_stage, 'run') WHEN operation_name LIKE 'oma.e2b.%' THEN 'E2B:' || operation_name ELSE 'HTTP ' || http_response_status_code END AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE (operation_name = 'oma.session.error' OR (operation_name = 'oma.session.status' AND oma_stop_reason = 'retries_exhausted') OR (operation_name = 'oma.sandbox_mcp.call' AND oma_outcome NOT IN ('ok', 'canceled')) OR (operation_name LIKE 'chat %' AND span_status = 'ERROR' AND error_type <> 'canceled') OR ((operation_name LIKE 'oma.runner.%' OR operation_name LIKE 'oma.e2b.%') AND span_status = 'ERROR') OR (http_response_status_code LIKE '5%' AND http_response_status_code <> '529')) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: 用户等首 token p50 / p95
panels.description: user.message 写入到首 token；排队、Brain 领取、注册与模型首 token 都包含在内

queries.query: WITH e AS (SELECT oma_session_id, operation_name, _timestamp, LEAD(operation_name) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_op, LEAD(_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_ts, LEAD(oma_model_time_to_first_token_s) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_ttft FROM oma_server WHERE (operation_name = 'POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/events' AND oma_input_event_types LIKE '%user.message%') OR operation_name LIKE 'chat %') SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont((next_ts - _timestamp) / 1000000.0 + CAST(next_ttft AS DOUBLE), 0.5), 2) AS y_axis_1, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont((next_ts - _timestamp) / 1000000.0 + CAST(next_ttft AS DOUBLE), 0.95), 2) AS y_axis_2 FROM e WHERE operation_name = 'POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/events' AND next_op LIKE 'chat %' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: 回合时长 p50 / p95
panels.description: session.status_running 到随后 session.status_idle 的时间

queries.query: WITH t AS (SELECT oma_session_id, _timestamp, oma_event_type, LEAD(_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_ts, LEAD(oma_event_type) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_type, LEAD(oma_stop_reason) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS stop_reason FROM oma_server WHERE operation_name = 'oma.session.status' ) SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont((next_ts - _timestamp) / 1000000.0, 0.5), 2) AS y_axis_1, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont((next_ts - _timestamp) / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS y_axis_2 FROM t WHERE oma_event_type = 'session.status_running' AND next_type = 'session.status_idle' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: 最近有问题的会话
panels.description: 点击行打开会话诊断；按最后一次问题时间倒序

queries.query: SELECT oma_session_id AS session_id, to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)) AS last_problem, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.session.error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS session_errors, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.session.status' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_turns, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.sandbox_mcp.call' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tool_failures, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name LIKE 'chat %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS model_errors, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name LIKE 'oma.runner.%' OR operation_name LIKE 'oma.e2b.%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS startup_failures, array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.session.error' THEN 'session.error' WHEN operation_name = 'oma.session.status' THEN '回合失败:' || oma_stop_reason WHEN operation_name = 'oma.sandbox_mcp.call' THEN '工具:' || oma_outcome WHEN operation_name LIKE 'chat %' THEN '模型:' || error_type WHEN operation_name LIKE 'oma.runner.%' THEN '启动:' || COALESCE(oma_stage, 'run') WHEN operation_name LIKE 'oma.e2b.%' THEN 'E2B:' || operation_name ELSE 'HTTP ' || http_response_status_code END), ', ') AS problems FROM oma_server WHERE oma_session_id IS NOT NULL AND (operation_name = 'oma.session.error' OR (operation_name = 'oma.session.status' AND oma_stop_reason = 'retries_exhausted') OR (operation_name = 'oma.sandbox_mcp.call' AND oma_outcome NOT IN ('ok', 'canceled')) OR (operation_name LIKE 'chat %' AND span_status = 'ERROR' AND error_type <> 'canceled') OR ((operation_name LIKE 'oma.runner.%' OR operation_name LIKE 'oma.e2b.%') AND span_status = 'ERROR') OR (http_response_status_code LIKE '5%' AND http_response_status_code <> '529')) GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY last_problem DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: 错误与告警日志（按实例和事件）
panels.description: WARN/ERROR 日志按实例聚合；同一实例突然大量出现时多半是依赖断开（例如 NATS 连接关闭）

queries.query: SELECT service_name, service_instance_id, severity, body, count(*) AS n, to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)) AS last_seen FROM oma_server WHERE severity IN ('ERROR', 'WARN') AND body NOT IN ('http request', 'http response') GROUP BY service_name, service_instance_id, severity, body ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT count(DISTINCT oma_session_id) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE operation_name = 'oma.session.status' AND oma_event_type = 'session.status_idle'

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, oma_stop_reason AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE operation_name = 'oma.session.status' AND oma_event_type = 'session.status_idle' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, error_type || ' ' || COALESCE(oma_retry_status, '') AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE operation_name = 'oma.session.error' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

WITH t AS (SELECT oma_session_id, _timestamp, oma_event_type, LEAD(_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_ts, LEAD(oma_event_type) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_type, LEAD(oma_stop_reason) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS stop_reason FROM oma_server WHERE operation_name = 'oma.session.status' ) SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont((next_ts - _timestamp) / 1000000.0, 0.5), 2) AS y_axis_1, ROUND(approx_percentile_cont((next_ts - _timestamp) / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS y_axis_2 FROM t WHERE oma_event_type = 'session.status_running' AND next_type = 'session.status_idle' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

WITH t AS (SELECT oma_session_id, _timestamp, oma_event_type, LEAD(_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_ts, LEAD(oma_event_type) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_type, LEAD(oma_stop_reason) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS stop_reason FROM oma_server WHERE operation_name = 'oma.session.status' ) SELECT CASE WHEN (next_ts - _timestamp) < 5000000 THEN '0-5s' WHEN (next_ts - _timestamp) < 15000000 THEN '5-15s' WHEN (next_ts - _timestamp) < 60000000 THEN '15-60s' WHEN (next_ts - _timestamp) < 300000000 THEN '1-5min' ELSE '>5min' END AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM t WHERE oma_event_type = 'session.status_running' AND next_type = 'session.status_idle' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, CASE WHEN body = 'oma_task_admitted' THEN '成功' ELSE '失败 ' || COALESCE(failure_reason, '') END AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE body IN ('oma_task_admitted', 'oma_task_admission_failed') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: 各节点利用率
panels.description: 活跃会话 / 该节点容量；只显示在线期间

panels.title: 释放与耗尽
panels.description: 服务端收到的释放（按原因）与准入耗尽

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, CASE WHEN body = 'brain worker released code session' THEN '释放·' || reason WHEN body = 'brain worker claims exhausted' THEN '耗尽·次数上限' ELSE '耗尽·永久失败' END AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE body IN ('brain worker released code session', 'brain worker claims exhausted', 'brain worker reported permanent admission failure') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: 会话退役原因
panels.description: DSH 释放会话的原因：idle、capacity、inbound_ended、blocked、shutdown 等

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, reason AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE body = 'oma_session_retired' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: 租约丢失与心跳失败（按节点）

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, service_instance_id || ' ' || body AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE body IN ('ccrv2_lease_lost', 'ccrv2_heartbeat_failed') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: DSH 警告与错误事件（按节点）

queries.query: SELECT service_instance_id, body, failure_reason, severity, count(*) AS n, to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)) AS last_seen FROM oma_server WHERE service_name = 'oma-brain' AND severity IN ('WARN', 'ERROR') GROUP BY service_instance_id, body, failure_reason, severity ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: HTTP 5xx
panels.description: 逐条统计 HTTP span（不观测的路由见日志）

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE http_response_status_code LIKE '5%'
SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE severity = 'ERROR'

panels.title: 状态采集失败
panels.description: 状态 gauge 的 DB/NATS 采集失败日志条数

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE body LIKE 'collect %'
SELECT http_route || ' ' || http_response_status_code AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE http_response_status_code LIKE '5%' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 20
topk(15, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$instance"}[15m]))))

panels.title: 数据库连接池占用率（按实例）
River 任务耗时 p95（按类型）
River 任务排队 p95（按类型）
webhook consumer 待处理 / 待 ack / 重投

queries.query: SELECT service_instance_id, body, COALESCE(stream, '') AS stream, COALESCE(consumer, '') AS consumer, count(*) AS n, to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)) AS last_seen FROM oma_server WHERE body LIKE 'collect %' GROUP BY service_instance_id, body, stream, consumer ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: ERROR 日志（按组件 / 事件）

queries.query: SELECT service_name, COALESCE(component, '') AS component, body, count(*) AS n, to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)) AS last_seen FROM oma_server WHERE severity = 'ERROR' GROUP BY service_name, component, body ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: 会话概要
panels.description: 一行汇总：回合、模型、工具、领取与错误。claims > 1 表示发生过接管或重新派发

queries.query: SELECT to_timestamp_micros(min(_timestamp)) AS first_seen, to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)) AS last_seen, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.session.status' AND oma_event_type = 'session.status_idle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS turns, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.session.status' AND oma_event_type = 'session.status_idle' AND oma_stop_reason = 'end_turn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS end_turn, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.session.status' AND oma_event_type = 'session.status_idle' AND oma_stop_reason NOT IN ('end_turn', 'requires_action') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_turns, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name LIKE 'chat %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS model_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name LIKE 'chat %' THEN CAST(gen_ai_usage_input_tokens AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) AS input_tokens, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name LIKE 'chat %' THEN CAST(gen_ai_usage_output_tokens AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) AS output_tokens, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.sandbox_mcp.call' AND oma_mcp_method = 'tools/call' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tool_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.sandbox_mcp.call' AND oma_mcp_method = 'tools/call' AND oma_outcome NOT IN ('ok', 'canceled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tool_failures, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.brain_claim.issue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS claims, SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.session.error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS session_errors, SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_spans FROM oma_server WHERE (oma_session_id = '$session_id' OR oma_code_session_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT oma_code_session_id FROM oma_server WHERE oma_session_id = '$session_id' AND oma_code_session_id IS NOT NULL))

panels.title: 回合
panels.description: 每个 running → idle 区间

queries.query: WITH t AS (SELECT oma_session_id, _timestamp, oma_event_type, LEAD(_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_ts, LEAD(oma_event_type) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS next_type, LEAD(oma_stop_reason) OVER (PARTITION BY oma_session_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS stop_reason FROM oma_server WHERE operation_name = 'oma.session.status' AND oma_session_id = '$session_id') SELECT to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp) AS started, ROUND((next_ts - _timestamp) / 1000000.0, 1) AS seconds, stop_reason FROM t WHERE oma_event_type = 'session.status_running' AND next_type = 'session.status_idle' ORDER BY started ASC

panels.title: 耗时构成（秒）
panels.description: 按类别汇总叶子耗时：排队与等待来自 span 属性；首次工具调用包含惰性建沙箱，因此沙箱准备与工具执行有重叠

queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN operation_name LIKE 'chat %' THEN '模型调用' WHEN operation_name = 'oma.sandbox_mcp.call' THEN '工具执行（含首次建沙箱）' WHEN operation_name LIKE 'oma.runner.%' AND operation_name <> 'oma.runner.run' THEN '沙箱与运行时准备' WHEN operation_name = 'oma.runner.run' THEN '启动排队' ELSE '等待用户确认' END AS x_axis_1, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'oma.runner.run' THEN COALESCE(CAST(oma_runner_queue_wait_s AS DOUBLE), 0) WHEN operation_name = 'oma.tool_permission.respond' THEN COALESCE(CAST(oma_tool_permission_wait_s AS DOUBLE), 0) ELSE duration / 1000000.0 END), 2) AS y_axis_1 FROM oma_server WHERE (oma_session_id = '$session_id' OR oma_code_session_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT oma_code_session_id FROM oma_server WHERE oma_session_id = '$session_id' AND oma_code_session_id IS NOT NULL)) AND (operation_name LIKE 'chat %' OR operation_name = 'oma.sandbox_mcp.call' AND oma_mcp_method = 'tools/call' OR (operation_name LIKE 'oma.runner.%' AND operation_name <> 'oma.runner.run') OR (operation_name = 'oma.runner.run' AND oma_runner_queue_wait_s IS NOT NULL) OR operation_name = 'oma.tool_permission.respond') GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: 模型调用
panels.description: 每次 chat span

queries.query: SELECT to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp) AS time, gen_ai_request_model AS model, ROUND(duration / 1000000.0, 2) AS seconds, ROUND(CAST(oma_model_time_to_first_token_s AS DOUBLE), 2) AS ttft, CAST(gen_ai_usage_input_tokens AS BIGINT) AS input_tokens, CAST(gen_ai_usage_output_tokens AS BIGINT) AS output_tokens, gen_ai_response_finish_reasons AS finish, span_status, error_type, trace_id FROM oma_server WHERE (oma_session_id = '$session_id' OR oma_code_session_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT oma_code_session_id FROM oma_server WHERE oma_session_id = '$session_id' AND oma_code_session_id IS NOT NULL)) AND operation_name LIKE 'chat %' ORDER BY _timestamp ASC

panels.title: 工具调用与权限
panels.description: 沙箱 MCP 调用、权限请求与答复

queries.query: SELECT to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp) AS time, operation_name, COALESCE(oma_tool_name, oma_mcp_method) AS tool, oma_outcome, oma_decision, oma_behavior, ROUND(duration / 1000.0, 1) AS duration_ms, ROUND(CAST(oma_tool_permission_wait_s AS DOUBLE), 1) AS wait_s, trace_id FROM oma_server WHERE (oma_session_id = '$session_id' OR oma_code_session_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT oma_code_session_id FROM oma_server WHERE oma_session_id = '$session_id' AND oma_code_session_id IS NOT NULL)) AND operation_name IN ('oma.sandbox_mcp.call', 'oma.tool_permission.request', 'oma.tool_permission.respond') ORDER BY _timestamp ASC

panels.title: 时间线
panels.description: 该会话与其 code session 的全部 span（已排除轮询与高频回调）

queries.query: SELECT to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp) AS time, operation_name, ROUND(duration / 1000.0, 1) AS duration_ms, span_status, oma_stage, oma_runner_trigger, oma_outcome, oma_tool_name, oma_event_type, oma_stop_reason, error_type, oma_worker_epoch, oma_runner_queue_wait_s, trace_id FROM oma_server WHERE (oma_session_id = '$session_id' OR oma_code_session_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT oma_code_session_id FROM oma_server WHERE oma_session_id = '$session_id' AND oma_code_session_id IS NOT NULL)) AND operation_name NOT IN ('GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}', 'GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}/events', 'POST /v1/code/sessions/{code_session_id}/worker/events', 'POST /v1/code/sessions/{code_session_id}/worker/internal-events', 'GET /v1/code/sessions/{code_session_id}/worker/internal-events', 'PUT /v1/code/sessions/{code_session_id}/worker', 'POST /v1/code/sessions/{code_session_id}/worker/events/delivery', 'oma.e2b.set_timeout', 'oma.e2b.service_endpoint') ORDER BY _timestamp ASC

SELECT to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp) AS time, operation_name, ROUND(duration / 1000.0, 1) AS duration_ms, oma_stage, oma_outcome, error_type, trace_id FROM oma_server WHERE span_status = 'ERROR' AND (oma_session_id = '$session_id' OR oma_code_session_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT oma_code_session_id FROM oma_server WHERE oma_session_id = '$session_id' AND oma_code_session_id IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY _timestamp ASC

panels.title: 该会话的日志
panels.description: 服务端与 Brain 日志，按 code session 与 trace 关联

queries.query: SELECT to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp) AS time, severity, service_name, body, reason, error_type, trace_id FROM oma_server WHERE body NOT IN ('http request', 'http response') AND (session_id = '$session_id' OR code_session_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT code_session_id FROM oma_server WHERE session_id = '$session_id' AND code_session_id IS NOT NULL) OR trace_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT trace_id FROM oma_server WHERE session_id = '$session_id')) ORDER BY _timestamp ASC
